restrictions: Complete fixed-IV SHA-1 with prefix rounds 0 through 78, standard padding and feed-forward, and all 160 output bits.
Inputs are independent uniform 32-byte messages; ideal random-word access is the charged primitive in collision-frontier-v3.
A single bounded N=2^80 attempt uses two arrays and deterministic merge sort; identical-input matches are excluded.
Analytic upper bounds only: no executed full-scale search, stored collision advice, cryptanalytic heuristic, or claimed improvement over the nominal reference.
